name: Scroll Reveal List
description: Dark editorial page with a staggered hero intro followed by alternating image and text rows that slide and fade in on scroll and reverse when scrolling back up.
contents: Full-height hero with eyebrow, title, subtitle and scroll hint
Alternating rows of grayscale image and text block with tag, title and multi-line description
behavior: Hero lines fade up in a stagger on load
Images slide in from the left or right when they enter the viewport and slide out when scrolling back
Text lines rise and fade in with a stagger and reverse on scroll back
Rows stack vertically on small screens and alternate sides from the md breakpoint

props.name: heroSubtitle
props.default: An editorial exploration of scroll-driven interface depth.

editableByProps: Number of rows, all text, images and slide direction per row
Hero texts, background and text colors
Animation duration, easing and slide distance

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the point where rows trigger
needsCodeEdit.where: start values "top 88%" and "top 85%" in the ScrollTrigger.create calls
grayscale class on the img element

fixed: Hero fills the full viewport height
Dark neutral accents (borders, tag and body text grays) are fixed classes
Reveal animations replay in reverse when scrolling back up
